description: This file implements the functions of an advanced TCP socket object for the Ansc Lpcco Tcp component within the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes initialization, cleanup, accept connections, set output, remove socket, query received data, process synchronous and asynchronous data, send completion, and notification handling functions. The code is focused on managing TCP socket lifecycle, data processing, and event notifications.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpDwoInit(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the TCP object; currently a placeholder that always returns success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpDwoUnload(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Unloads the TCP object; currently a placeholder that always returns success.

methods.name: BOOL AnscLpccoTcpDwoAccept(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PANSC_HANDLE phClientContext)
methods.description: Handles accepting a new TCP connection, allocates a buffer descriptor, and associates it with the socket. Returns TRUE.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpDwoSetOut(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Sets output for the socket; currently a placeholder that always returns success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpDwoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Removes and cleans up a socket, freeing buffers, updating connection timers, and managing client context.

methods.name: ULONG AnscLpccoTcpDwoQuery(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,PANSC_HANDLE phQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes incoming data, managing buffer descriptors to assemble complete messages, handles partial messages, and calls the 'Recv' method when a complete message is available.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpDwoProcessSync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Synchronous process handler, currently marked as not applicable.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpDwoProcessAsync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Asynchronous process handler, currently marked as not applicable.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpDwoSendComplete(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved,ANSC_STATUS status)
methods.description: Handles completion of sends; currently a placeholder returning success.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpDwoNotify(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,ULONG ulEvent,ANSC_HANDLE hReserved)
methods.description: Handles socket events such as errors, closure, resource events, and timeouts by invoking methods on the socket object.
